abstract: Audits chain-of-custody protocols and determines required data validation work hours
system_message:
You are the Forensic Data Quality Auditor (QA). Your responsibilities are to audit chain-of-custody protocols and determine required data validation work hours, as well as to review evidence archive retention parameters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evidence archive retention（ARCH）
information_points.content:
QA-ARCH-UDY：For the Continuous Sonic Drilling Survey, the specimen freezer storage duration is established at 180 d in minus-80 cryogenic storage for split core reference archives.
QA-ARCH-NFV：The High-Resolution Passive PDB Array provides a specimen freezer storage duration of 365 d for split core reference archives in minus-80 cryogenic storage.
QA-ARCH-09P：The Deep-Core Vibracoring Protocol maintains a specimen freezer storage duration of 90 d for split core reference archives in minus-80 cryogenic storage.

information_points.title: Audits chain-of-custody protocols and determines required data validation work hours（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
QA-AUDIT-RF0：For the High-Resolution Passive PDB Array within the Nanjing audit jurisdiction, data quality validation hours are evaluated at 35 h for raw spectral validation and sample custody audits.
QA-AUDIT-K2R：Under the Suzhou audit jurisdiction, the Deep-Core Vibracoring Protocol requires 35 h of data quality validation hours for sample custody audits and raw spectral data validation covering blanks, duplicates, and spectral peak deconvolutions.
QA-AUDIT-VZI：Under the Nanjing audit jurisdiction, the Deep-Core Vibracoring Protocol requires 50 h of data quality validation hours for sample custody audits and raw spectral data validation reviewing blanks, duplicates, and peak deconvolutions.
QA-AUDIT-UIJ：Under the Nanjing audit jurisdiction, the Continuous Sonic Drilling Survey requires 50 h of data quality validation hours for senior auditor reviews covering blanks, duplicates, and spectral peak deconvolutions.
